week_focus: Finding MCP servers, OpenClaw skills, and agent orchestration tools to enhance JCF HQ's trading, research, and management capabilities.

findings.name: CoinCap MCP Server
findings.why_it_matters: Enables Huncho and Crisp to fetch real-time cryptocurrency data, historical trends, and technical analysis tools directly into their context without needing custom API integrations. Essential for evaluating crypto setups.

findings.name: Composer Trade MCP
findings.why_it_matters: Allows LLMs to backtest investment ideas and execute automated trading strategies. This directly aligns with Crisp and Blade's mission to optimize and execute trades programmatically.

findings.name: Agent HQ
findings.why_it_matters: A mission control system designed to orchestrate and manage multiple AI agents. For JCF HQ, it provides a centralized UI to assign tasks, monitor progress, and review audit logs for Huncho, Crisp, Blade, and Oracle.

findings.name: Awesome OpenClaw Skills (VoltAgent)
findings.why_it_matters: A centralized repository of skills designed specifically for OpenClaw. Since JCF HQ runs on OpenClaw, this provides ready-to-install drop-in capabilities to immediately expand the agents' toolsets.

findings.name: MCP Dashboard (bryankthompson)
findings.why_it_matters: An open-source web dashboard for monitoring multiple MCP servers. Provides JCF HQ with observability into which tools the agents are calling, performance metrics, and error rates.

findings.name: Wrike MCP Server
findings.why_it_matters: Integrates project management directly with AI models. This allows Huncho to autonomously create, track, and manage long-term tasks, research goals, and weekly performance reviews for Jase.

summary: This week's research focused on expanding JCF HQ's operational capabilities through the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent orchestration. The top finds are specialized MCP servers for real-time crypto data (CoinCap) and automated trading (Composer), which will directly empower Crisp and Blade. Additionally, discovering the Awesome OpenClaw Skills repository provides an immediate, install-ready pathway to upgrade Huncho's capabilities. For infrastructure, Agent HQ and open-source MCP dashboards offer the necessary UI and observability to manage the growing team of sub-agents effectively.
